Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly selected D (invention of the microscope) instead of the ground-truth answer C (continued experimentation) for disproving spontaneous generation. This reflects a misinterpretation of the primary mechanism of disproof—historical experiments by Redi, Spallanzani, and Pasteur—conflating technological visualization with the experimental evidence that overturned the belief. The Planner also prematurely declared TASK_COMPLETE without engaging available specialists or systematically validating the answer.
